lines.text: Here's how to build an agent that briefs you every morning, in under sixty seconds.
A daily brief agent reads your Slack and GitHub on a schedule, and posts one short summary.
Say it's Tuesday: a hundred and forty messages, twenty-five pull requests.
Step one: agent dot M D. A model, its tools, and the steps, in plain English.
The key rule: only what you'd act on today earns a line.
Step two: deployment dot M D. Weekdays at seven thirty-two, with a five dollar cap per run.
Step three: memory. Your preferences, which it can't edit, and bookmarks, so a late run misses nothing.
Then run ant apply. Each morning, a fresh session reads from every bookmark, re-checks each item, and posts the brief.
No server to keep alive. And a source it can't read says unreadable, never a quiet day.
